This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' was a green or blue skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|race]].

==Biology and Description==
The species was humanoid, and sported bright red eyes and eight horn-like protrusions on top of the head, with blue or green skin.

==History==
A notable member of this species was [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell]], a leading member of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]].
